This payroll reconciliation obtains both its expected and observed totals from the same payroll export, so equality only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
The scan-triage review lets the imaging model assess its own classifications, so approval only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
That sensor calibration uses the sensor under test as its own reference signal, so a pass only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
The tally verification takes its expected totals from the same tabulator it audits, so a match only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.

test_set.english: This translation quality check asks the translating model to score its own translation, so approval only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.

That fraud appeal is reviewed only by the model whose fraud flag is being challenged, so confirmation only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
The loan-risk validation treats labels supplied by the risk model as ground truth for that model, so agreement only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.

The emissions assurance recomputes its reference figure with the same calculator it evaluates, so a match only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
That species benchmark uses labels produced by the classifier as ground truth for that classifier, so agreement only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
